summary: Retest of Goorin Intl Shipments polish features against fresh bundle. All 5 requested behaviors now PASS end-to-end in the browser: (1) is-kpi-released is a <button>, click filters to only IS-0012 with is-filter-status='prepaid' and class 'is-kpi on'; second click restores 3 rows. (2) New shipment created with customer 'A', factory 'B' produces IS-0013 with attention chip text 'IS-0013 A · Needs packing list', and IS-0011 chip reads '... Awaiting prepayment'. (4) Hovering is-row-IS-0012, getComputedStyle(row.querySelector('.is-c4--last'), '::after').opacity === '1'. (5) No page errors; only pre-existing benign Recharts width/height warnings observed.
